page.overview:
Who is Sheraine Caminelle?

Sheraine Caminelle is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah captured by the Seanchan at Falme and renamed Mylen.

Sheraine is slender and very short, indicating that she is from Cairhien. She is a pretty little woman, 4'10 tall, pale with dark hair and eyes. She physically resembles fellow Cairhienin Moiraine Damodred.

Upon her capture by the Seanchan, she refuses to eat and becomes skin and bones. After Tuon takes her in, she becomes healthier, plumper and rounder of bosom and bottom.

When the Seanchan arrive at Falme, Sheraine and her Warder are ambushed and her Warder killed. She is made damane and renamed Mylen. She refused to cooperate with the sul'dam holding her, refusing to eat or drink, and nearly died. She was taken back to Seanchan, and Tuon bought her on the docks at Shon Kifar. All of the der'sul'dam had despaired and expected her to die, but Tuon successfully trained her. Mylen has become a perfect damane and was chosen to be one of six damane to accompany Tuon across the Aryth Ocean.
